work_order.confidence_rationale: Read path is new code over the merged expense ledger with the schema match verified directly (payer/share/split_input present, no payment table), every 0n literal and sr-only direction confirmed at its call site, and both GroupOverview test suites identified as prop-change casualties; per-person home aggregation from caller-involved transfers is the one piece with no existing pattern to copy, and QA fixtures depend on manual flows, which is what keeps this at 80 rather than 90.
work_order.debate_summary: The critique was an empty object with no findings, so there was nothing to accept, rebut, or split — I judged the proposal directly against the code and plan/brief.md instead. I verified each load-bearing claim myself and all checked out. The proposal (v2) already incorporates what a critic would have cited against v1: Money renders direction sr-only so IAC-1 needs the money.tsx fix plus the ui.test.tsx update, the GroupOverview prop change breaks group-overview-empty.test.tsx as well as group-screens.test.tsx, and docs/ui.md line 106 settles the home breakdown as per-person rather than per-group. I confirmed v2 was right to drop v1's member-actions.tsx edit — both LeaveButton and RemoveButton already render the server formError via role=alert, so no change is needed there. No finding contradicted the binding decisions (stored split rule, TR-4 rewrite). One thing both proposal versions missed, noted in residual_risks rather than added to scope: the group overview's activity-partial state has no IAC in this ticket.
